subject.title: fix: restore live Gateway model verification

question: Should the release live-Gateway verification now adopt the canonical workspace and bounded transcript-projection retry behavior on this branch?
rationale: The patch changes a credentialed release-verification gate rather than ordinary isolated tests, and the protected `maintainer` label requires an explicit human decision on the intended release-automation contract.

options.title: Approve the canonical verification path
options.body: Merge after the remaining exact-head checks complete and the reviewer accepts the bounded retry as the correct representation of transient projection readiness.

options.title: Keep the existing gate behavior
options.body: Do not merge if maintainers want release verification to fail immediately on any transcript-projection delay rather than model the documented transient state.

recommendation.title: Approve the canonical verification path
recommendation.body: Merge after the remaining exact-head checks complete and the reviewer accepts the bounded retry as the correct representation of transient projection readiness.
